title: ME446 (Robot Dynamics and Controls): Manipulator Obstacle Course
summary: Along with a partner, I implemented variable impedance control using Jacobian force mapping with straight line trajectories to traverse the end-effector through peg insertion, zig-zag corridors, and pressing an egg within an applied load range of 500-1000g. This was the culmination of the semester's work where we started from the ground up, developing the analytical forward and inverse-kinematics ourselves and learning to apply it into joint and task space controllers written in C.
